title: Broadcom Stock (AVGO) Rises 8.8% as Chip Stocks Rebound (Nov 9)
summary: Broadcom stock (AVGO) closed at $319.48 on Nov 9, up 8.78%, as chip stocks bounced. What drove the move and what to watch before Dec 9 results.
body_markdown:
## Why Broadcom Stock Rose


According to[TIKR](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/real-winner-google-135-billion-204531962.html) , chip stocks bounced after Nvidia's board said it would[investigate a relationship involving CEO Jensen Huang](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-spy-affair-probe-rattles-markets/) . TIKR wrote that Broadcom's gain "had nothing to do with Google," even though Google unveiled two new versions of its TPUs the same day.


As reported by[GuruFocus](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/broadcom-stocks-jump-8-21-180538383.html) , the rally came after the chipmaker set December 9 for its fiscal fourth-quarter and full-year results, with investors eyeing its $21.7 billion AI revenue guidance. GuruFocus also cited Investing.com pointing to Broadcom's VM API project entering the Cloud Native Computing Foundation Sandbox.


That guidance comes from the company itself. According to[Broadcom's September 2 results release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001730168/000173016826000076/avgo-08022026x8kxex99.htm) , the company expects fiscal fourth-quarter revenue of about $34.8 billion, up 93% from a year earlier, including AI semiconductor revenue of $21.7 billion, up 236%.


## AVGO Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- AI chip demand: per Broadcom's third-quarter release, revenue rose 86% to $29.6 billion and AI semiconductor revenue grew 221% to $16.7 billion, with CEO Hock Tan saying demand for its custom AI accelerators and networking "continues to be very strong."
- Google TPU work: TIKR noted that Broadcom disclosed, in an April 6 filing, a deal to supply Google with TPUs and networking through as late as 2031, and cited Bloomberg Intelligence, which expects TPU sales to grow from about $12 billion this year to more than $135 billion by 2028.


### Risks


- Recent swings: TIKR noted that Broadcom had dropped 15% in the prior week before Monday's rebound, and GuruFocus noted the stock had set its 52-week low only days earlier.
- Competition at Google: according to TIKR, Broadcom's management expects Google to use other suppliers, and MediaTek is building a version of Google's next TPU.
- Results test: Broadcom's[earnings report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) is due on December 9, per GuruFocus and TIKR, and GuruFocus framed AI semiconductor revenue against the $21.7 billion guidance as the key point to watch.
